description: This Java class 'DefaultPubSubConfig' provides a default implementation of the 'PubSubConfig' interface, encapsulating configuration parameters for a pub/sub system, including seed, hash family size, restart delay, update interval, and force update probability.

classes.name: DefaultPubSubConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing PubSubConfig, managing pub/sub configuration parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultPubSubConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getSeed
methods.description: Returns the seed string used in pub/sub configuration.

methods.name: getHashFamilySize
methods.description: Returns the hash family size parameter.

methods.name: getForceUpdateProbability
methods.description: Returns the probability of force update.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on configuration fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on configuration fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the configuration object.
